title: discovery may overwrite owner-set mailbox_host on each round
description: In discovery.rs run_discovery_round, a successful probe upserts the contact via upsert_discovered_contact with the Tailscale-verified IP as mailbox_host. If the owner has manually edited a contact mailbox_host (e.g. to a MagicDNS name), the next discovery round silently overwrites it with the raw IP. Whether upsert_discovered_contact preserves owner-set fields is not visible from kithd source. If it does not, manual contact configuration is silently clobbered by discovery.
